name: Trunk-based development
description: Short-lived branches merged to main at least daily. Default for all teams. See playbook/delivery/source-control.md.

name: Architecture decision records
description: MADR 4.0 records in docs/decisions next to the code. Required for decisions that are costly to reverse.

name: OpenTelemetry
description: SDKs and Collector for traces, metrics and logs over OTLP. Runs on cloud, on-premises and air-gapped. Owner: platform team.

name: Kubernetes
description: Managed service on public cloud, self-managed distribution on-premises and air-gapped. Golden path templates target it.

name: Harbor
description: Internal OCI registry with replication, vulnerability scanning and signature checks. Required for air-gapped sites.

name: Argo CD
description: GitOps deployment for Kubernetes and the golden path default. Works fully offline from an internal git server. See playbook/delivery/gitops-and-deployment.md.

name: Cosign key-pair signing
description: Moved from Assess this quarter after a one-page spike. Sign images and SBOMs with keys held in an HSM or KMS, where keyless signing cannot reach public Sigstore services. One team in trial until end of Q2.

name: OpenBao
description: Open source secrets manager forked from HashiCorp Vault. Assess licence, support options and migration effort before any production use.

name: Self-hosted code assistant models
description: Open-weight models served inside our network for code classified Confidential or above. Assess quality, GPU cost and licence terms.

name: Go
description: Default language for new backend services and command-line tools. Service template available.

name: Rust
description: Allowed for performance-critical and memory-safety-critical components. Owner and code review pool required.

name: Long-lived feature branches
description: Feature branches that live for weeks cause painful merges and hide integration problems. Use trunk-based development and feature flags.
